key_insight: In situ thermal welding is used to build a PBAT/rGO porous network that helps create shape-stable composite phase-change materials.
engineering_relevance: The approach is relevant for thermal energy storage coatings or structures where maintaining shape during phase change is important.
method: Apply in situ thermal welding to strengthen the network
Use the welded porous matrix to host phase-change material
evidence_signal: The abstract indicates this is a journal article in Journal of Materials Science, but it does not provide performance metrics in the supplied text.
watch_item: Without quantitative thermal cycling or leakage data in the abstract, the practical durability and scalability of the process remain uncertain.
paper_title: In situ thermal welding for constructing PBAT/rGO porous structures for shape-stable composite phase-change materials
